svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Make three. Tube 34 mm OD x 130 mm, polycarbonate, 2 mm wall.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Board: inclinometer, microcontroller, RS-485 transceiver and 3.3 V

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: regulator, at most 28 mm wide, flashed and bench-read first.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Mark the board's X axis with an arrow on the tube label: the arrow

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: points downslope when the capsule is lowered (step 4).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Lead: 0.8 m of 4-core 0.25 mm2 shielded cable, out of the top centre.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Seal the bottom with a glued disc, slide the board in on a

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: printed carrier square to the tube, and pot it full with

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: polyurethane potting compound; cure as its maker says.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Glue a centring collar flush on each end (SLW-DWG-103).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: rests on the stand tube on its lower collar, centred in the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: pipe by both collars; the foam plug sits 10 mm above it.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: reads within 0.1 degree of a spirit level on the bench.
